title: Handling Urges & Developing Cognitive Coping Strategies
description: An interactive group workshop focusing on practical impulse delay, 5-4-3-2-1 sensory grounding, and identifying environmental temptation triggers.
speaker: Sunita Deshmukh (M.Phil Clinical Psychology)

title: Athlete Forum: Clean Supplement Decisions & Medical Safety
description: Dr. Priya Nair breaks down how to read sports nutrition batch labels, avoid unverified pre-workouts, and verify prescription medications before trials.
speaker: Dr. Priya Nair (MD Sports Medicine)

title: Managing Competitive Burnout & Resisting Locker-Room Shortcuts
description: Explore sports psychology tools to navigate training plateaus, fear of falling behind peers, and the cognitive distortion of 'everyone else is doing it'.
speaker: Dr. Keith Robertson (PhD Sport Psychology)

title: Medical Insights: Why Abrupt Drug Cessation Requires Clinical Care
description: A clinical overview of physical dependence vs psychological tolerance, the dangers of unsupervised cold-turkey withdrawal, and medical detoxification pathways.
speaker: Dr. Rajesh K. Sharma (MD Psychiatry)
